# Sensory Environment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensoryEnvironment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

Ambient perceivable conditions at a specific location and time — the ensemble of physical properties that can be measured by instruments or perceived by observers. A [`SensoryEnvironment`](gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) is reified as a first-class entity (not merely a property bag) so that measurements and perceptions about it can carry provenance, confidence, temporal scope, and standpoint indexing. Measured conditions are expressed as [`CoordinateMatrix`](gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) values in measurement reference frames; perceived conditions are standpoint-indexed values in MentalReferenceFrames ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): co-equal facets, no privileged representation).
